title: 3x Weekly Maintenance Program
author: Joe F.
desc: The PostGreece Maintenance Program is an 8-week training regimen designed to help you maintain your fitness gains with just three focused sessions each week. This program strategically blends strength and conditioning exercises to keep your body in peak form while allowing for recovery and adaptation. Perfect for those looking to sustain their progress after an active getaway, it emphasizes consistency and balance, ensuring you stay on track without feeling overwhelmed. Dive in and keep your momentum going!
